content: Moderation in good fortune is only apprehension of the shame that attends upon intoxication with success.
author: François de La Rochefoucauld
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. True wisdom is rarely complicated or flashy, but it demands the honesty to look at our own habits and assumptions without defensive excuses.

Across his life and work, François de La Rochefoucauld saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. When you stop looking for external validation and anchor your self-worth in quiet integrity, the noisy chaos of the world loses its power over you. A good life is built day by day through small, conscious choices.
reflectionPrompt: How can acknowledging your vulnerability help you build deeper self-trust and inner peace?
